en.name: AGRecorder
en.short_description: High-framerate screen recorder with dual-channel system + mic audio
en.subtitle: Voice recorder with location
en.description:
AGRecorder is a voice recorder that remembers where you were.

RECORD
One button. Start, stop, done. Audio is captured as AAC and written straight to your device.

LOCATION
Each recording can carry the coordinates it was made at. AGRecorder asks the device for GPS first; if that is unavailable it falls back to an approximate lookup, and it always tells you which of the two produced the fix rather than presenting a guess as a reading.

PERMISSIONS, PLAINLY
Microphone access is what makes the app work. Location is used only to tag a recording, and only if you let it. Nothing is uploaded on your behalf.
